title: Verify Parts Technician can return a part from a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role.
A work order line has a part that has been picked/received onto the line.
Note: per spec v33, returning a part from a work order requires NO permission. (Distinct from SV-7838 and from deleting a Parts > Returns record, which needs Invoicing Delete.)
steps:
1. Open the work order line that has the part.
2. Open the part's action menu, click Return, and confirm.
